questions.q: How does a row filter differ from a plain GRANT SELECT on a table?
options: A GRANT is all-or-nothing; a row filter is a UDF evaluated per row that excludes rows where it returns false
A row filter replaces GRANT entirely — tables with a row filter need no SELECT grant at all
A row filter only works on views, never on tables
A row filter is enforced only in notebooks, not in SQL warehouses
questions.explain: GRANT SELECT is binary (all rows or none). A row filter is a registered SQL function evaluated against every row at query time; rows where it returns false are silently excluded.

questions.q: In `CREATE FUNCTION us_filter(region STRING) RETURN IF(IS_ACCOUNT_GROUP_MEMBER('admin'), true, region = 'US');`, what do non-admin users see when they query a table with this filter applied?
options: Only rows where region = 'US'
Every row in the table, same as admins
No rows at all
Only rows where region is NULL
questions.explain: Non-admins fail the IS_ACCOUNT_GROUP_MEMBER('admin') check, so the function falls through to region = 'US', filtering the result to U.S. rows only.

questions.q: In the mapping-table pattern, which built-in function identifies the querying user inside the filter function?
options: SESSION_USER()
CURRENT_CATALOG()
GET_TAG_VALUE()
HAS_TAG()
questions.explain: SESSION_USER() returns the identity of the user running the query, which the filter function compares against the usernames stored in the mapping table.

questions.q: What must you do before running DROP FUNCTION on a function that's attached to a table as a row filter?
options: Run ALTER TABLE ... DROP ROW FILTER on the table first
Nothing — DROP FUNCTION automatically detaches any row filters first
Re-grant SELECT on the table
Disable Unity Catalog on the workspace
questions.explain: Dropping the function before removing the row filter reference leaves the table pointing at a function that no longer exists, making the table inaccessible until the orphaned filter is dropped.

questions.q: How many row filters can a single table have at once?
options: One
Unlimited — they combine with AND
Up to three
Zero — row filters apply only to views
questions.explain: Each table can have exactly one row filter function attached via ALTER TABLE ... SET ROW FILTER.
